issues.issue: The combining schedules (p14, p16, p19) show this line is mostly NPPD lease 169,922 (84,961 General + 84,961 Street, 82%), with franchise fees 8,014 and small 'Other' amounts. The SoA (p2) also prints 'NPPD lease unrestricted 169,922'. The dominant category is charges for services/fees (rentals), with a review naming the mix; 'other' is a last resort.

Includes Rural Fire Department - cost share 648,212 (p16). The rules list rural fire contracts under charges for services/fees, and that amount alone is 57% of the line. Also includes Motor vehicle fees 13,646, which belongs under motor vehicle tax. The line is kept as printed with a review, which is defensible, but its category may be wrong.
The rules put rural fire contracts under charges for services/fees. It is printed under the Intergovernmental heading, so this is a judgment call (already marked review).

The source isn't stated anywhere. The all-funds budget schedule (p13) shows 'Intergovernmental - federal' with no actual and 'Grants' 222,384 as a separate line, so the federal source is not established. The same applies to detail[69] (Fire Grants 8,541) and detail[77] (Ambulance Grants 213,843).
